evidence.finalAssistantMessage: REVIEW_PLAN was blocked because candidate validation received an invalid SPEC_PATH; no publication occurred.

rootCause: The live REVIEW_PLAN producer failed to publish because its candidate SPEC_PATH was invalid. The preserved evidence does not identify a repository or runtime defect beyond the producer turn; the strict candidate validator and official recovery remained in control.
authorityDecision: No source change. Use one fresh C retry to obtain a valid review-plan publication and test C24; do not relax SPEC_PATH validation or add a retry to the workflow state machine.
